answer: A jade ledger can anchor anti-Sybil defence if standing is earned through a linked chain of useful work, not a single signup. Each newcomer starts one crystal-clear task; its verified output becomes the input of the next task, so progress is a continuous chain. A zephyr-fast burst of fresh identities gains nothing, because each chain must be walked step by step and every link is checked by an unrelated reviewer. Skipping or breaking a link resets the chain, while completed chains earn slowly rising rights. One operator cannot walk many chains at once.
